question: What project lifetime, discount rate and membrane service life were assumed in the techno-economic analysis of the forward osmosis systems?
rendered:
According to page 6 of the document, the techno-economic analysis assumed a project lifetime of 20 years. 

According to page 6 of the document, the techno-economic analysis assumed a discount rate of 8%.

According to page 7 of the document, the techno-economic analysis assumed a membrane service life of 5 years.
